name: qlik-to-sigma
description: Migrate Qlik Sense / Qlik Cloud apps to Sigma — discovery via qlik-cli or corectl unbuild, Qlik-expression → Sigma-formula translation (incl. Set Analysis + calculated LOAD fields), REST-only warehouse catalog preflight, data model + source-covered workbook build, and parity verification. Also migrates legacy QlikView (.qvw) apps from the -prj project folder. Includes a tenant assessment skill.
